source_title: WAC 284-34-150, What are the standards for prima facie credit life insurance rates? (Washington State Legislature)
basis: per month per one thousand dollars of outstanding insured debt
rate_table_note: Rates are in WAC 284-34-150(1)(a), printed as "Sixty cents" and "Ninety-six cents". Single premium rates are computed from these with the formula in (2) (not recorded). WAC 284-34-210: the commissioner reviews the rates every three years and publishes new statewide rates if needed. Filed 1/4/05, effective 4/1/05 (WSR 05-02-076, Matter No. R 2002-02); no later amendment is listed in the section.
summary: Rates in force: Washington's prima facie credit life rates in WAC 284-34-150: 60 cents (single life) and 96 cents (joint life) per month per $1,000 of outstanding insured debt, effective April 1, 2005.

source_title: WAC 284-34-170, What are the standards for credit accident and health insurance rates? (Washington State Legislature)
basis: per one hundred dollars of initial insured debt
rate_table_note: Rates are the single premium table in WAC 284-34-170(1)(a), by number of months (1 to 120) and nonretroactive (14-, 30-day) or retroactive (7-, 14-, 30-day) benefits; months 12 and 60 recorded. Composite monthly rates per $1,000 of insured net debt for open-end plans are in (2)(f) ($1.06, $0.81, $1.72, $1.58, $1.18). Joint is 1.6 times single (3). Filed 1/4/05, effective 4/1/05 (WSR 05-02-076, Matter No. R 2002-02); no later amendment is listed in the section.
summary: Rates in force: Washington's prima facie single premium credit accident and health rates in WAC 284-34-170, per $100 of initial insured debt, for 12 and 60 months, effective April 1, 2005.
